scenes.headline: How Hunyuan-A13B stores 80B but reads 13B
scenes.sub: Tencent's sparse experts, and a switch for thinking
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Sencha! Hunyuan A thirteen B stores eighty billion parameters, but each token uses about thirteen billion. Here's how.

scenes.text: Each layer keeps 64 small experts and 1 shared one. A router wakes 8 per token, so most weights sit idle.
scenes.say: Each layer keeps sixty-four small experts and one shared one. A router wakes eight per token, so most weights sit idle.

steps.say: A token first passes attention, where thirty-two query heads share eight key-value heads.
A router scores sixty-four experts, and only the top eight run.
One shared expert runs on every token.
The outputs are summed and passed up, thirty-two layers deep.

scenes.title: Parameters stored vs read per token
scenes.say: Counting the weight files: eighty point three nine billion stored, twelve point seven five billion read per token.

scenes.title: Four stages after pretraining
scenes.say: After twenty trillion tokens of pretraining, four stages follow.

items.say: Reinforcement learning with answer checks and a code sandbox.
Fine-tuning on writing, dialogue and agents.
Reinforcement learning with generative reward models.

left.title: Fast: /no_think
left.say: A no think tag leaves the think block empty, and the model answers at once.

right.title: Slow: the default
items: Chosen by /think, or by no tag
right.say: With no tag, it reasons step by step first. Slow is the default.

scenes.title: Same weights, slow versus fast
scenes.note: The report gives no token counts per mode
scenes.say: Thinking lifts AIME twenty twenty-five from nineteen point two to seventy-six point eight. On one tool-calling test, fast mode wins.

scenes.text: Sparse experts cut the weights a token reads. The switch skips reasoning tokens. Hard maths still needs the slow path.
scenes.mark: Hard maths still needs the slow path
scenes.say: Sparse experts cut the weights a token reads. The switch skips reasoning tokens. Hard maths still needs the slow path.

recap: Slow thinking is the default; /no_think skips it
scenes.say: Sixty-four experts, eight routed, one shared. About thirteen of eighty billion read per token. Slow thinking, unless you ask.
